changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT h.client_token AS client, (substr(h.business_date,1,4)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,5,2)||'-'||substr(h.business_date,7,2))::DATE AS process_date, h.arrival_id, h.tx_count, COALESCE(vl.accepted, 0) AS accepted_count, COALESCE(vl.rejected, 0) AS rejected_count, GREATEST(h.tx_count - COALESCE(vl.accepted,0) - COALESCE(vl.rejected,0), 0) AS pending_count, cir.outcome AS cir_outcome, (cir.written_at IS NOT NULL) AS cir_written, COALESCE(em.emission_count, 0) AS emission_count, COALESCE(em.member_count, 0) AS emitted_member_count, COALESCE(ir.n, 0) AS isr_reply_count, COALESCE(sr.n, 0) AS sbsr_reply_count, COALESCE(pr.n, 0) AS pbsr_reply_count, (CASE WHEN COALESCE(em.emission_count,0) = 0 AND COALESCE(vl.rejected,0) > 0 THEN 'VALIDATION_FAILED' WHEN COALESCE(em.emission_count,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(em.member_count,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(pr.n,0) >= em.member_count THEN 'REPLIED' WHEN COALESCE(em.emission_count,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(pr.n,0) > 0 THEN 'PARTIALLY_REPLIED' ELSE 'EMITTED' END)::STRING AS conservative_state FROM public.tx_header h LEFT JOIN (SELECT arrival_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'PASS') AS accepted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome LIKE 'FAIL%') AS rejected FROM public.validation_log GROUP BY arrival_id) vl ON vl.arrival_id = h.arrival_id LEFT JOIN public.cir_response cir ON cir.arrival_id = h.arrival_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.arrival_id, count(DISTINCT e.id) AS emission_count, count(m.id) AS member_count FROM public.crw_emission e LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_member m ON m.emission_id = e.id GROUP BY e.arrival_id) em ON em.arrival_id = h.arrival_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.arrival_id, count(*) AS n FROM public.isr_resp r JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id GROUP BY e.arrival_id) ir ON ir.arrival_id = h.arrival_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.arrival_id, count(*) AS n FROM public.sbsr_resp r JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id GROUP BY e.arrival_id) sr ON sr.arrival_id = h.arrival_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.arrival_id, count(*) AS n FROM public.pbsr_resp r JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id GROUP BY e.arrival_id) pr ON pr.arrival_id = h.arrival_id WHERE h.client_token = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal'

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT client, process_date, count(*) AS arrivals, sum(tx_count) AS tx_count, sum(accepted_count) AS accepted_tx, sum(rejected_count) AS rejected_tx, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cir_outcome = 'ACK') AS ack_arrivals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cir_outcome = 'NACK') AS nack_arrivals, sum(emission_count) AS emissions, sum(pbsr_reply_count) AS pbsr_replies, count(*) FILTER (WHERE conservative_state = 'REPLIED') AS replied_arrivals FROM rpt.v_arrival_status WHERE client = upper(current_user::STRING) OR current_user = 'rpt_internal' GROUP BY client, process_date

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'MSG_ID'::STRING AS key_type, h.msg_id::STRING AS key_value, h.client_token::STRING AS client, h.arrival_id, h.arrival_id AS related_arrival_id, NULL::STRING AS job_name, 'tx_header'::STRING AS source_table, h.id AS source_key FROM public.tx_header h UNION ALL SELECT 'END_TO_END_ID'::STRING, t.e2e::STRING, h.client_token::STRING, t.arrival_id, t.arrival_id, NULL::STRING, 'tx_entry'::STRING, t.id FROM public.tx_entry t JOIN public.tx_header h ON h.arrival_id = t.arrival_id UNION ALL SELECT 'MSG_ID'::STRING, c.msg_id::STRING, c.client::STRING, c.arrival_id, c.arrival_id, NULL::STRING, 'cir_response'::STRING, c.id FROM public.cir_response c UNION ALL SELECT 'END_TO_END_ID'::STRING, r.e2e::STRING, COALESCE(g.client, split_part(r.response_file, '_', 1))::STRING, e.arrival_id, e.arrival_id, NULL::STRING, 'isr_resp'::STRING, r.id FROM public.isr_resp r LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.id = e.group_id UNION ALL SELECT 'END_TO_END_ID'::STRING, r.e2e::STRING, COALESCE(g.client, split_part(r.response_file, '_', 1))::STRING, e.arrival_id, e.arrival_id, NULL::STRING, 'sbsr_resp'::STRING, r.id FROM public.sbsr_resp r LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.id = e.group_id UNION ALL SELECT 'END_TO_END_ID'::STRING, r.e2e::STRING, COALESCE(g.client, split_part(r.response_file, '_', 1))::STRING, e.arrival_id, e.arrival_id, NULL::STRING, 'pbsr_resp'::STRING, r.id FROM public.pbsr_resp r LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.id = e.group_id ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT g.id AS group_id, g.arrival_id, g.client::STRING AS client, g.source_msg_id::STRING AS source_msg_id, g.run_date, count(e.id) AS emission_count, count(e.visible_at) AS visible_count, count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.visible_at IS NULL) AS not_visible_count, min(e.visible_at) AS first_crw_visible_at, max(e.visible_at) AS last_crw_visible_at FROM public.crw_emission_group g LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.group_id = g.id GROUP BY g.id, g.arrival_id, g.client, g.source_msg_id, g.run_date ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT w.client::STRING AS client, count(*) AS watermark_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.last_status NOT IN ('ACSC', 'RJCT')) AS non_terminal_rows, min(w.updated_at) AS oldest_watermark_at, max(w.updated_at) AS latest_watermark_at, (extract(epoch FROM (now() - min(w.updated_at))) / 3600.0)::DECIMAL(12,2) AS oldest_watermark_age_hours, (extract(epoch FROM (now() - max(w.updated_at))) / 3600.0)::DECIMAL(12,2) AS hours_since_last_advance FROM public.prg_watermark w GROUP BY w.client ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'STAGED_NOT_WRITTEN'::STRING AS wedge_class, c.client::STRING AS client, c.arrival_id, NULL::STRING AS job_name, c.route_id::STRING AS route, c.file_name::STRING AS subject, c.created_at AS stuck_since, (extract(epoch FROM (now() - c.created_at)) / 3600.0)::DECIMAL(12,2) AS age_hours, (c.outcome || ' staged, written_at IS NULL')::STRING AS detail, 'cir_response'::STRING AS source_table FROM public.cir_response c WHERE c.written_at IS NULL AND c.created_at < now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'EMISSION_VISIBLE_NO_REPLY'::STRING, COALESCE(g.client, split_part(e.file_name, '_', 1))::STRING, e.arrival_id, NULL::STRING, 'fint-req'::STRING, e.file_name::STRING, e.visible_at, (extract(epoch FROM (now() - e.visible_at)) / 3600.0)::DECIMAL(12,2), 'emission visible, no ISR/SBSR/PBSR reply after 4h'::STRING, 'crw_emission'::STRING FROM public.crw_emission e LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.id = e.group_id WHERE e.visible_at IS NOT NULL AND e.visible_at < now() - INTERVAL '4 hours' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.isr_resp r WHERE r.emission_id = e.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.sbsr_resp r WHERE r.emission_id = e.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.pbsr_resp r WHERE r.emission_id = e.id) ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root') ORDER BY stuck_since
